object_description: four identical building volumes arranged around a central square
design_condition: The four volumes follow the planted-alley geometry beside the sports fields, establish a central square within a park, and relate the fragmented urban fabric to nearby institutional buildings.

positive.statement: The precise siting and well-measured massing provide an appropriate urban and territorial response.

position.rationale: Four compact volumes are visibly arranged around a central square with consistent spacing.

positive.statement: The rigorous ground-plan composition brings order to the fragmented urban fabric and establishes a formal relationship with surrounding institutional buildings.

position.rationale: The top view clearly shows an ordered four-part composition around the central open space.

positive.statement: The project is fundamentally sound, with foundations, structure, energy, and sustainable development well understood.

position.rationale: This evaluates technical and environmental resolution without a specific visible geometric location.

positive.statement: The compact buildings and recommended construction methods lead to an economical project.

position.rationale: The four compact rectilinear volumes are directly visible in plan and elevations.

negative.statement: The disappearance of the openings makes the courtyards introverted and removes their identity and permeability to the outside.

position.rationale: Central courtyard voids are visible, with limited openings toward the exterior perimeter.

negative.statement: The identical buildings do not suggest a hierarchy of access or a differentiated distribution of the program.

position.target: hierarchy of access and program distribution
position.rationale: Repeated volumes provide a circulation anchor, but access hierarchy is not distinguishable.

negative.statement: The proximity of the facades puts many rooms in the unfortunate situation of facing one another.

position.rationale: Opposing parallel facades around the central square are clearly visible.

negative.statement: The outdoor spaces of the children's center in front of busy walkways are unconvincing.

position.rationale: A perimeter open zone is used because the children's center is not separately identifiable.

negative.statement: The plan and cross-section lack flexibility and appear fixed in their ability to respond to context.

position.rationale: Identical rectilinear volumes visibly suggest a fixed repeated response across the site.
